description: Arena Confirm Bug Match. WHEN: an arena admin confirms or rejects a flagged bug-hit match. decision:'confirmed' removes a confirmed bug loss from the official record everywhere (/r/stats, player-page widget, per-game); decision:'rejected' leaves the record unchanged. Admin key required. Example: arena_confirm_bug_match {"match_id":"<match_id>","decision":"<decision>"}

decision.description: confirmed to remove the bug loss from the official record; rejected to keep the record unchanged.
